ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; high-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 3-5% of the visible fluke area against a dominant low-intensity black/dark grey background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with proximal convexity near the median notch and distal concavity toward the lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small white focal scars distributed across the surface; prominent white pigmentation/scarring at the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular jagged morphology on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal tip.
